    "bgCustom": {
      "name": "Golden Sunset Edge",
      "code": "// Golden Sunset Edge (2560 × 720). Xenon 5.2 calls draw with elapsed seconds.\nconst WIDTH = 2560;\nconst HEIGHT = 720;\nconst WATER_X = 640;\nconst WATER_RIGHT = 2448;\nconst WATER_TOP = 354;\nconst WATER_WIDTH = WATER_RIGHT - WATER_X;\nconst WATER_HEIGHT = HEIGHT - WATER_TOP;\nconst SOURCE_BYTES = 346586;\n\n// Tuning values. Lengths are pixels in the approved crop, times are seconds,\n// and exposure values are fractional changes in the sampled photograph.\nconst WAVES = [\n  { period: 14, near: 12, far: 72, weight: 0.72, phase: 0.3 },\n  { period: 18.5, near: 17, far: 83, weight: 0.20, phase: 2.1 },\n  { period: 11.25, near: 10, far: 57, weight: 0.08, phase: 4.4 },\n];\nconst HORIZON_DISPLACEMENT = 2.75;\nconst BASE_HORIZON_DISPLACEMENT = 1.4 / 1.5;\nconst FOREGROUND_DISPLACEMENT = 9.4;\nconst DISTANT_WATER_END = 1 / 3;\nconst FOREGROUND_START = 2 / 3;\nconst SHORE_PHASE_EASE_PX = 14;\nconst SHORE_FEATHER = 18;\nconst SHORE_SAMPLE_MARGIN = 5;\nconst SIDE_FEATHER = 26;\nconst FRAME_EDGE_FEATHER = 42;\nconst SUN = { x: 1460, y: 220, radius: 61, period: 13, exposure: 0.18 };\nconst REFLECTION = {\n  x: 1421, width: 87, end: 579, exposure: 0.24, shimmerFraction: 0.16, period: 6.3,\n};\nconst TAU = Math.PI * 2;\n\n// Inward water contours measured on this crop. Values at the silhouettes\n// include a small safety margin before any feathered movement begins.\nconst SHORE = [\n  [640, 385], [890, 379], [1135, 375], [1300, 372], [1398, 361],\n  [1423, 358], [1600, 358], [1830, 358], [2000, 360], [2094, 365],\n  [2150, 404], [2220, 423], [2448, 462],\n];\nconst BOAT_EDGE = [\n  [354, 698], [447, 699], [464, 713], [480, 736], [510, 755],\n  [544, 773], [579, 773], [609, 759], [648, 727], [720, 700],\n];\nconst RIGHT_BANK = [\n  [354, 2094], [399, 2098], [445, 2112], [489, 2134],\n  [546, 2202], [620, 2315], [720, 2448],\n];\n\nlet scene;\nlet photo;\n\nfunction clamp01(value) {\n  return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value));\n}\n\nfunction smooth(value) {\n  const x = clamp01(value);\n  return x * x * (3 - 2 * x);\n}\n\nfunction curve(points, x) {\n  for (let index = 1; index < points.length; index++) {\n    const [x1, y1] = points[index];\n    if (x <= x1) {\n      const [x0, y0] = points[index - 1];\n      return y0 + (y1 - y0) * clamp01((x - x0) / (x1 - x0));\n    }\n  }\n  return points[points.length - 1][1];\n}\n\nfunction surface(width, height) {\n  const layer = document.createElement('canvas');\n  layer.width = width;\n  layer.height = height;\n  return layer.getContext('2d');\n}\n\nfunction readImage(image, x, y, width, height) {\n  const target = surface(width, height);\n  target.drawImage(image, x, y, width, height, 0, 0, width, height);\n  return target.getImageData(0, 0, width, height);\n}\n\nfunction loadPhotograph(assets) {\n  // Xenon accepts two ordinary PNG assets within its limits. Their opaque RGB\n  // channels carry the exact JPEG byte stream. No fetch or filesystem access.\n  const bytes = new Uint8Array(SOURCE_BYTES);\n  const partSize = Math.ceil(SOURCE_BYTES / 2);\n  for (let part = 0; part < 2; part++) {\n    const image = part === 0 ? assets.photo_a : assets.photo_b;\n    const count = Math.min(partSize, SOURCE_BYTES - part * partSize);\n    if (!image || image.naturalWidth * image.naturalHeight * 3 < count) {\n      throw new Error('Golden Sunset is missing a photographic asset.');\n    }\n    const rgba = readImage(image, 0, 0, image.naturalWidth, image.naturalHeight).data;\n    for (let byte = 0, channel = 0; byte < count; byte++, channel++) {\n      bytes[part * partSize + byte] = rgba[channel];\n      if (channel % 4 === 2) channel++;\n    }\n  }\n\n  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: 'image/jpeg' }));\n  const image = new Image();\n  image.onload = () => {\n    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n    if (image.naturalWidth === WIDTH && image.naturalHeight === HEIGHT) photo = image;\n    else photo = new Error('Golden Sunset expects the approved 2560 × 720 photograph.');\n  };\n  image.onerror = () => {\n    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n    photo = new Error('Golden Sunset could not decode the embedded photograph.');\n  };\n  image.src = url;\n}\n\nfunction makeWaterMask() {\n  const mask = surface(WATER_WIDTH, WATER_HEIGHT);\n  const pixels = mask.createImageData(WATER_WIDTH, WATER_HEIGHT);\n  const shoreline = new Float32Array(WATER_WIDTH);\n  for (let x = 0; x < WATER_WIDTH; x++) shoreline[x] = curve(SHORE, WATER_X + x + 0.5);\n  for (let row = 0; row < WATER_HEIGHT; row++) {\n    const y = WATER_TOP + row + 0.5;\n    const left = curve(BOAT_EDGE, y);\n    const right = curve(RIGHT_BANK, y);\n    const start = Math.max(0, Math.floor(left - WATER_X));\n    const end = Math.min(WATER_WIDTH, Math.ceil(right - WATER_X));\n    for (let col = start; col < end; col++) {\n      const x = WATER_X + col + 0.5;\n      // Leave room for upward water sampling without pulling in the bank.\n      const shore = smooth((y - shoreline[col] - SHORE_SAMPLE_MARGIN) / SHORE_FEATHER);\n      const side = smooth(Math.min(x - left, right - x) / SIDE_FEATHER);\n      pixels.data[(row * WATER_WIDTH + col) * 4 + 3] = 255 * shore * side;\n    }\n  }\n  mask.putImageData(pixels, 0, 0);\n  return mask.canvas;\n}\n\n// Cache only the positive RGB difference from the source. Additive compositing\n// leaves the original photo underneath and contributes nothing at baseline.\nfunction lightLayer(image, x, y, width, height, maximum, opacity) {\n  const original = readImage(image, x, y, width, height).data;\n  const bright = surface(width, height);\n  const plus = bright.createImageData(width, height);\n  for (let row = 0; row < height; row++) {\n    for (let col = 0; col < width; col++) {\n      const index = (row * width + col) * 4;\n      const alpha = opacity(x + col + 0.5, y + row + 0.5, original, index);\n      if (alpha <= 0) continue;\n      for (let channel = index; channel < index + 3; channel++) {\n        const value = original[channel];\n        plus.data[channel] = Math.min(255 - value, value * maximum);\n      }\n      plus.data[index + 3] = 255 * alpha;\n    }\n  }\n  bright.putImageData(plus, 0, 0);\n  return { x, y, layer: bright.canvas };\n}\n\nfunction sunMask(x, y) {\n  const radius = Math.hypot(x - SUN.x, y - SUN.y);\n  // Keep the small white disc fixed and give its existing halo room to breathe.\n  return (0.24 + 0.76 * smooth((radius - 9) / 11)) * (1 - smooth(radius / SUN.radius));\n}\n\nfunction reflectionMask(x, y, pixels, index) {\n  const depth = clamp01((y - WATER_TOP) / (REFLECTION.end - WATER_TOP));\n  const axis = 1465 - 8 * depth;\n  const halfWidth = 24 - 8 * depth;\n  const across = 1 - smooth((Math.abs(x - axis) - 5) / halfWidth);\n  const ends = smooth((y - WATER_TOP) / 12) * (1 - smooth((y - 545) / 34));\n  // The reflection has a blue component where the surrounding amber water\n  // generally does not. Include the gold shoulders through the green channel.\n  const highlight = Math.max(\n    smooth((pixels[index + 2] - 53) / 125),\n    0.55 * smooth((pixels[index + 1] - 163) / 82),\n  );\n  return across * ends * highlight;\n}\n\nfunction makeBands() {\n  const rows = [];\n  for (let y = WATER_TOP; y < HEIGHT;) {\n    rows.push(y);\n    y += 3 + Math.floor(4 * (y - WATER_TOP) / WATER_HEIGHT);\n  }\n  rows.push(HEIGHT);\n  const carrier = new Float64Array(rows.length * WAVES.length * 2);\n  const offsets = new Float64Array(rows.length);\n  for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index++) {\n    const y = rows[index];\n    const depth = (y - WATER_TOP) / WATER_HEIGHT;\n    const depthAmplitude = BASE_HORIZON_DISPLACEMENT +\n      (FOREGROUND_DISPLACEMENT - BASE_HORIZON_DISPLACEMENT) * depth ** 1.35;\n    // Lift the distant and middle water, then blend into the foreground curve.\n    const distantBoost = (HORIZON_DISPLACEMENT - BASE_HORIZON_DISPLACEMENT) *\n      (1 - smooth((depth - DISTANT_WATER_END) / (FOREGROUND_START - DISTANT_WATER_END)));\n    const amplitude = (depthAmplitude + distantBoost) * smooth((HEIGHT - y) / FRAME_EDGE_FEATHER);\n    // Ease the tightest wave spacing slightly at the shore. The stronger\n    // displacement needs this to keep adjacent sampled bands in order.\n    const phaseEase = SHORE_PHASE_EASE_PX * Math.max(0, 1 - depth / DISTANT_WATER_END) ** 3;\n    for (let wave = 0; wave < WAVES.length; wave++) {\n      const { near, far, weight, phase } = WAVES[wave];\n      // Integrate 1/wavelength with depth so constant-phase lines travel down\n      // continuously and spread out as they approach the foreground.\n      const angle = TAU * WATER_HEIGHT / (far - near) *\n        Math.log1p((far - near) * depth / near) + phase + TAU * phaseEase / near;\n      const cell = (index * WAVES.length + wave) * 2;\n      carrier[cell] = Math.sin(angle) * amplitude * weight;\n      carrier[cell + 1] = Math.cos(angle) * amplitude * weight;\n    }\n  }\n  return { rows, carrier, offsets };\n}\n\nfunction prepare(image) {\n  return {\n    water: surface(WATER_WIDTH, WATER_HEIGHT),\n    waterMask: makeWaterMask(),\n    sun: lightLayer(image, SUN.x - SUN.radius, SUN.y - SUN.radius,\n      SUN.radius * 2, SUN.radius * 2, SUN.exposure, sunMask),\n    reflection: lightLayer(image, REFLECTION.x, WATER_TOP, REFLECTION.width,\n      REFLECTION.end - WATER_TOP, REFLECTION.exposure, reflectionMask),\n    bands: makeBands(),\n    time: new Float64Array(WAVES.length * 2),\n  };\n}\n\nfunction updateOffsets(t, bands, time) {\n  for (let wave = 0; wave < WAVES.length; wave++) {\n    const angle = TAU * t / WAVES[wave].period;\n    time[wave * 2] = Math.cos(angle);\n    time[wave * 2 + 1] = Math.sin(angle);\n  }\n  const { carrier, offsets } = bands;\n  let cell = 0;\n  for (let row = 0; row < offsets.length; row++) {\n    let shift = 0;\n    for (let wave = 0; wave < time.length; wave += 2) {\n      shift += carrier[cell++] * time[wave] - carrier[cell++] * time[wave + 1];\n    }\n    offsets[row] = shift;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction paintWater(ctx, image, t, pulse, state) {\n  const { water, waterMask, bands, time } = state;\n  const { rows, offsets } = bands;\n  updateOffsets(t, bands, time);\n  water.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';\n  for (let row = 0; row < rows.length - 1; row++) {\n    const top = rows[row];\n    const height = rows[row + 1] - top;\n    const sample = top + offsets[row];\n    const sampleEnd = rows[row + 1] + offsets[row + 1];\n    const sampleHeight = sampleEnd - sample;\n    const dest = top - WATER_TOP;\n    // Neighboring bands share the same source boundary. This keeps the warp\n    // continuous while allowing the engine to interpolate subpixel movement.\n    water.drawImage(image, WATER_X, sample, WATER_WIDTH, sampleHeight,\n      0, dest, WATER_WIDTH, height);\n  }\n  if (pulse > 0) addReflection(state, t, pulse);\n  water.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in';\n  water.drawImage(waterMask, 0, 0);\n  ctx.drawImage(water.canvas, WATER_X, WATER_TOP);\n}\n\nfunction addReflection(state, t, pulse) {\n  const { water, reflection, bands: { rows, offsets } } = state;\n  water.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';\n  for (let row = 0; row < rows.length - 1; row++) {\n    const top = rows[row];\n    const height = rows[row + 1] - top;\n    const sample = top + offsets[row];\n    if (sample >= REFLECTION.end) break;\n    const sampleEnd = rows[row + 1] + offsets[row + 1];\n    const start = Math.max(sample, WATER_TOP);\n    const end = Math.min(sampleEnd, REFLECTION.end);\n    if (start >= end) continue;\n    const scale = height / (sampleEnd - sample);\n    const mid = top + height / 2;\n    const shimmer = Math.sin(TAU * (mid / 80 - t / REFLECTION.period) +\n      0.38 * Math.sin(t * 0.77 + mid * 0.022));\n    // Modulate the added light alone. At zero pulse the warped photo is left\n    // untouched, and no shimmer phase can subtract from it.\n    water.globalAlpha = pulse * (1 - REFLECTION.shimmerFraction * (1 - shimmer) / 2);\n    water.drawImage(reflection.layer, 0, start - WATER_TOP, REFLECTION.width, end - start,\n      reflection.x - WATER_X, top - WATER_TOP + (start - sample) * scale,\n      REFLECTION.width, (end - start) * scale);\n  }\n  water.globalAlpha = 1;\n}\n\nfunction draw(ctx, t, w, h, assets) {\n  if (!photo) return;\n  if (photo instanceof Error) throw photo;\n  if (!scene) scene = prepare(photo);\n\n  const scale = Math.min(w / WIDTH, h / HEIGHT);\n  const x = (w - WIDTH * scale) / 2;\n  const y = (h - HEIGHT * scale) / 2;\n  const pulse = (1 - Math.cos(TAU * t / SUN.period)) / 2;\n  ctx.save();\n  if (x > 0.01 || y > 0.01) {\n    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';\n    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);\n  }\n  ctx.translate(x, y);\n  ctx.scale(scale, scale);\n  ctx.drawImage(photo, 0, 0);\n  paintWater(ctx, photo, t, pulse, scene);\n  if (pulse > 0) {\n    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';\n    ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;\n    ctx.drawImage(scene.sun.layer, scene.sun.x, scene.sun.y);\n  }\n  ctx.restore();\n}\n\n// Xenon has decoded every bundled asset before running this setup.\nloadPhotograph(assets);\n",
      "assets": {
        "photo_a": "data:image/png;base64,",
        "photo_b": "data:image/png;base64,"
      },
      "fps": 12,
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
